name: BcDevEnv Test Runner
brief: OData test-runner endpoint for bcdevenv run-tests.
description: Exposes a 'BcDevEnvTestRunner' web service for 'bcdevenv run-tests'. RunAll runs the installed test codeunits via the Microsoft test framework toolkit; the per-codeunit protocol (PrepareTests, RunCodeunit, GetCodeunitResults) prepares a suite for one extension/test type/isolation, excludes the DisabledTests entries before execution and runs one codeunit per call. Results are returned as xUnit XML, which 'bcdevenv run-tests' converts to JUnit. With the altool executor, the 'BcDevEnv Reset ...' test codeunits run before every test codeunit to reset the test state (ApplicationArea, WorkDate, test initialization, permissions mock).
